snippet.title: Adventurers Shop | First Trailer
snippet.description:
Adventurers Shop is now on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4300400/Adventurers_Shop/
Forge your legacy as both merchant and hero. Explore Zoldar, battle monsters for rare materials, and craft epic gear. Team up with friends to build a thriving shop in the village markets or arm yourselves to conquer the dangerous depths of the wild.
